intro.popup_en: Rapid Development, Lesson 5: Material can be sacrificed for development speed. A lead in development can then be converted into an attack.
intro.popup:
快速出子第5课
牺牲物质换取出子速度，先手发展可以转化为攻势

outro.popup_en: A gambit is an advanced way to accelerate development when the resulting activity and initiative provide sufficient compensation.
outro.popup: 总结：弃兵是出子加速的高级手段

moves.popup_en: e4 opens the game.
moves.popup: e4开局

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central move.
moves.popup: e5对称

moves.popup_en: d4! White immediately attacks the center. The Danish Gambit begins, offering a pawn for rapid development.
moves.popup:
d4！主动攻击中心
丹麦弃兵开始！
白方准备主动弃兵换发展

moves.popup_en: ...exd4 accepts the gambit and captures the pawn.
moves.popup:
exd4接受
黑方吃兵，理所当然

moves.popup_en: c3! White offers a second pawn. The goal is not material but rapid development and open lines.
moves.popup:
c3！第2个弃兵！
白方又让黑方吃兵
换来什么？——快速出子！

moves.popup_en: ...dxc3 accepts the second pawn. Black is now two pawns ahead.
moves.popup:
dxc3接受
黑方得到2个兵

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the first minor piece to an ideal Italian bishop square, targeting f7. After only three moves, the bishop is already active.
moves.popup:
Bc4！白方第1个轻子
象到意大利格——最佳位置
瞄准f7！
注意：这里才走3步，白方象就到了最强位置

moves.popup_en: ...cxb2 captures another pawn. Black is three pawns ahead but remains behind in development.
moves.popup:
cxb2黑方继续吃兵
黑方得3个兵，但发展落后

moves.popup_en: Bxb2! White activates the second bishop in one move. It controls the long diagonal; White now has both bishops aimed toward the center.
moves.popup:
Bxb2！白方第2个轻子激活
只花1步，象到b2控制长对角线
现在白方有双象，轰炸中心！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's position. Black has three extra pawns, but the pieces are still undeveloped.
moves.popup:
d6黑方稳固
黑方有3个兵的优势，但子力未出

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops a third minor piece to an ideal square. Three moves have developed three pieces.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第3个轻子出动
马到最佳位置
3步走出了3个轻子！

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops a black knight as Black tries to catch up.
moves.popup:
Nc6黑方马出动
黑方开始追赶

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops the fourth minor piece. All four minor pieces are active, even though White is two pawns down.
moves.popup:
Nc3！第4个轻子出动
所有4个轻子全部出动！
白方发展完整，尽管少了2个兵

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 continues Black's development.
moves.popup: Nf6黑方继续发展

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles immediately after developing all four minor pieces. The king is safe and the rooks are connected.
moves.popup:
O-O！即刻易位
4个轻子全出，立即易位
王安全，车连通

moves.popup_en: ...Be7 develops Black's bishop.
moves.popup: Be7黑方象出动

moves.popup_en: Re1! White activates a rook on the e-file and supports the central advance. White sacrificed two pawns but gained a highly active position.
moves.popup:
Re1！车激活
占据e线，配合中心推进
弃了2兵但换来完美局面

moves.popup_en: ...O-O secures Black's king as well.
moves.popup: O-O黑方也易位

moves.popup_en: Qd2 develops the queen and coordinates White's attack.
moves.popup:
Qd2后出动
协调进攻

moves.popup_en: ...Bg4 pins a white piece and applies pressure.
moves.popup: Bg4黑方牵制

moves.popup_en: Nd5! White's knight jumps into the heart of Black's position. The development lead bought by the gambit has become a concrete attack.
moves.popup:
Nd5！白马跳入心脏
弃兵换来的先手转化为具体攻势！

moves.popup_en: ...Nxd5 captures the knight; Black has little choice but to accept the exchange.
moves.popup: Nxd5黑方必吃

moves.popup_en: exd5! White recaptures. The Danish Gambit gave up two pawns to activate both bishops and develop Nf3 and Nc3. Here, development speed becomes attacking pressure: a model example of sacrificing material for tempi.
moves.popup:
exd5！
总结：丹麦弃兵路线：
弃2兵→双象激活+Nf3/Nc3出动
出子速度=攻击优势
这是弃子换节奏的最佳范例！
